Frames below the gate are skipped. Lower the value if snoring is quiet.
Rhythm: 2 pulses of 0.5 s, 2 s apart (about %1$d s), then silence until the next repeat.

AntiSnorr posts a local notification and a companion app forwards it to the band. Works with both Gadgetbridge and Zepp: add AntiSnorr to the allowed app list (in Gadgetbridge — notification access; in Zepp — Device → App notifications).
Sends a DEBUG_SEND_NOTIFICATION broadcast. In Gadgetbridge enable Settings → Developer settings → Intent API → Debug → Allow debug commands.
Simulates an incoming call for a few seconds. Usually the strongest vibration. Requires the same \"Allow debug commands\" setting. Used for the fade-out rhythm (1 s pulses).
1. Install Gadgetbridge, pair the band and make sure it stays connected.

2. To use Gadgetbridge modes, enable \"Allow debug commands\" (Settings → Developer settings → Intent API → Debug). The Notification mode needs notification access in the companion app (Gadgetbridge or Zepp) instead.
3. In the companion app (Gadgetbridge or Zepp) enable notifications for AntiSnorr in the band\'s app-notification list.
4. Grant microphone and notification permissions to AntiSnorr and start monitoring.
5. Disable battery optimisation for AntiSnorr so Android does not kill the foreground service at night.
